reason: A client-side DSH interface customization plugin that animates a rainbow whale favicon and applies matching gradient styling to selected branding elements.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页提供彩色渐变流动的小鲸鱼 favicon，并将指定品牌元素同步彩色化。
summaries.en: A client-side DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an animated rainbow-gradient whale favicon and matching styling to selected branding elements.

capabilities: Replaces the DSH page favicon with an animated rainbow-gradient whale SVG
Applies animated gradient styling to specified page branding elements using CSS and SVG
Provides pause/resume and color-mode controls in the dynamic plugin form
Restores the original favicon when the plugin is disabled or unloaded
